notes: Session history: your past game sessions now show in the app
patch_notes: Every finished game session is now recorded (games played, start time, length, Game Mode time, whether a restore was needed) to history.json in ~/GameModeVPN, and the last 8 sessions show in a new SESSION HISTORY card. The file is capped at 50 entries and a corrupt file just shows as empty history. Covered by two new test rounds (21 for the engine records and storage, 22 for the GUI); all 22 rounds pass.
